Privacy statement

This site is informational. It has no accounts, no shop and no forms, and it does not collect personal data through the pages themselves.

Server logs

The hosting provider keeps technical logs, including IP addresses, to detect faults and abuse. Those logs are not used to build profiles of visitors and are not shared for any other purpose.

E-mail

A message sent to the address on the contact page contains an e-mail address and whatever the sender chooses to include. It is used to reply and for nothing else, and it is not passed on to third parties.

Links to other sites

Several pages link to other websites. Once a visitor follows such a link, the privacy terms of that site apply.

Requests

A request to see or delete correspondence can be sent to the address on the contact page.
